faq.a1: Create your account, upload a file and ask a question about it. You can also start by connecting your email or cloud files.
faq.a2: Yes. You can connect Gmail, Outlook, Google Drive, OneDrive and SharePoint. You can also upload files directly to Allybi.
faq.a3: Alongside its answer, Allybi shows where the information came from. You can open the file or email and check the passage in context.
faq.a4: No. With Outlook, you review and confirm before sending. For WhatsApp, Allybi opens the prepared message in the app, and you decide whether to send it.
faq.a5: No. Your files, questions and answers are not used to train artificial intelligence models.
faq.a6: Yes, you get 30 days free to use Allybi. After that, the subscription costs R$ 170 per month. You can cancel whenever you want.
